items.readme:
Craft Anything

English · 日本語 · 简体中文 · 한국어

See how any website, app or game works, then have AI build your own version; an open-source, clean-room engine in pure Rust.
Point it at a target, say what you want, and it studies the original with real inspection tools,
has a coding agent build a new project, checks the result against the original and refines it.

Download Craft Anything · ArtCraft · All Crafting Apps



A website project: each check says how alike the build is, you approve anything outside the rules, and the plan shows what's left.

> [!NOTE] > **ArtCraft is a community of artists from all walks of life.** Painters, photographers, > filmmakers, illustrators, designers, animators, hobbyists, and people who picked up a pencil > last week. If you make things, you're one of us. **[Come say hi on Discord](https://discord.gg/artcraft).**

How it works · Two ways to use it · AI · Agents · Under the hood · Get started · Status · Downloads · Discord


🔍 Study anything

Websites, desktop apps, phone apps, games and files: real inspection tools find out how they're built and what they do, with the evidence behind every answer.

🛠️ Build your own

Say what you want ("Recreate this website", "Recreate this game's gameplay in Rust") and a coding agent builds a new project in the stack you ask for.

✅ Checked, not guessed

Every build is compared with the original (pages at three screen widths, a game's own self-test, an app's runs) and refined until it's close.

🤖 Agent-ready

314 tools, each one a CLI command and an MCP tool, so any agent can drive the same engine the app uses. No AI is needed to inspect.

## How it works Point Craft Anything at a target, say what you want, and press Start. It works in four steps, asking you in plain words when a decision is yours: 1. **Study:** inspect the original: its pages at every width, its code, its files, how it runs. 2. **Build:** a coding agent builds a new project, in the language, framework or engine your request names (or a sensible default). 3. **Check:** compare the build with the original and list what doesn't match yet. 4. **Ready:** open, play or preview the result, or ask for changes and it refines it.

Make: pick what to recreate, say what you want, press Start.
Ready: play the game, or ask for changes below.
## Two ways to use it - **Simple** (default): "What do you want to make?" Pick a website, app or game, describe it, press Start. A project page shows the four steps (Study → Build → Check → Ready), what the agent is doing in plain words, question and approval cards, how alike the result is, and buttons to open the result or its folder. Ask for changes in the box at the bottom. "Just look inside" opens a target for questions without building anything (in Deep mode). - **Advanced**: the full workbench: every tool (Ctrl/Cmd+K), functions, strings, pseudo-C, disassembly, hex, call graphs, evidence, unknowns, jobs, logs and the agent console. Both modes drive the same engine. ## Clean room or Deep - **Clean room** (the default): nothing inside the original is read, not its code, files or page source. Craft Anything works from what you can see: pictures you add, the website as a visitor sees it (screenshots, visible text, measured layout, colours, fonts and spacing, menus opened) and, when you allow it, a picture of the app's window. Tools that would look inside are refused and say how to turn on Deep mode. - **Deep**: every tool is used, for your private use. A program's code and files are read with the built-in engines (and Ghidra when it's installed), a website's JavaScript is read and its start page watched, and the builder may use all of them. Switch in the title bar or Settings, with `settings_set deep_mode true`, or for one CLI run with `--deep` (or `--clean-room`).


Advanced: functions, pseudo-C, the agent and the evidence behind every answer.

## AI Building needs a coding agent on your computer. **Claude Code** is supported first: Craft Anything runs your own, unmodified `claude` program, which uses your own sign-in; Craft Anything never sees or handles your account. Your use of it falls under your own agreement with Anthropic. See [docs/claude-code.md](docs/claude-code.md) for how and why. A Codex adapter exists but hasn't been verified on a real install yet. Other agents that speak ACP (Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, opencode, goose, Hermes, Maki) can be switched to it per backend; of those, only Maki has been run live. Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter and local OpenAI-compatible servers are available for questions and analysis (Settings → AI). ## Built for agents Every tool is also a CLI subcommand and an MCP tool, so an agent can study a target or run a whole rebuild without the app: ```sh craft-anything-cli commands # every tool, by toolset craft-anything-cli mcp # serve them to any MCP client craft-anything-cli rebuild https://example.com "Recreate this website" ``` Results are evidence records with their confidence, coverage and limitations; big ones come back as a summary first and are paged with `core_evidence_browse`. `craft-anything-cli setup` connects Craft Anything to coding-agent apps. ## Under the hood A pure-Rust reverse-engineering engine with 314 tools (298 in the engine, the rest from the AI and setup layers) for native programs, .NET, Java, Android, Apple, Electron/JavaScript, websites, firmware, packet captures, databases and game files. Its own decoders, disassembler and decompiler work without any outside program; Deep mode uses them all, and Ghidra when it's installed. It powers the desktop app (egui), the CLI and the MCP server, and parts of it run in the browser as WebAssembly. The full list is in [docs/tools.md](docs/tools.md). ## Get started Requires Rust **1.97 or newer** (a dependency needs it; `rustup update`). On Debian or Ubuntu, the desktop app also needs: ```sh sudo apt-get install libxkbcommon-dev libwayland-dev libx11-dev libxrandr-dev libxi-dev libgl1-mesa-dev libgtk-3-dev ``` Then: ```sh git clone https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything && cd craft-anything cargo run --release -p craft-anything # the desktop app cargo install --path apps/craft-anything-cli # the CLI, as `craft-anything-cli` craft-anything-cli doctor # checks the install, coding agents and engines ``` Building needs a coding agent signed in on your computer (see [AI](#ai)); `doctor` says what's missing. Rebuild from the command line (questions are asked in the terminal): ```sh craft-anything-cli rebuild https://example.com "Recreate this website" craft-anything-cli rebuild - "A snake game in Rust" --rounds 1 craft-anything-cli rebuild https://example.com "Make the header blue" --continue-in "" craft-anything-cli rebuild - "Add a contact form" --project-folder "" --existing edit ``` New projects go in `Documents/Craft Anything` (change it in Settings → General). Each project folder holds `craft.json` (the request, target, status and history), `capture/` (what was recorded from the target), `app/` (the generated project), `checks/` (each comparison against the original), `investigation.cany/` (evidence) and `inbox/` (open questions). A project can also start in a folder you pick (Choose a folder… under Start, or `--project-folder`). If it already has files, you say what they are: the app itself, which the builder edits in place, or material to start from, with the app built in `app/` beside them (Settings → General can remember the answer). Settings → General also lists projects from more folders; removing one only takes it off the list. ## Status > [!IMPORTANT] > **Status:** Craft Anything is in early alpha. What works today, what is partial and what's next: > > - **Works today:** the desktop app (Simple and Advanced), the CLI and the MCP server; the > Study → Build → Check → Refine workflow for websites, apps and games with Claude Code as the > builder; website checks at three screen widths; game rebuilds in Unity, Unreal or Godot; Deep > mode with Ghidra; generated pictures and 3D models (opt-in, your own fal.ai key); plugins (MCP > servers, and WASM components in builds with the `wasm-plugins` option). > - **Partly there:** building with API keys and other coding agents (built, not yet run live), > behaviour checks for apps and games, a few engine tools tested only against stand-ins. > - **Next:** the first public release (installers for Windows, macOS, Linux and FreeBSD, and the > browser viewer are set up in CI), then the managed tier. > > [docs/STATUS.md](docs/STATUS.md) has the detail and how each part was checked, > [docs/tool-status.md](docs/tool-status.md) the tool-by-tool checklist, and > [docs/ROADMAP.md](docs/ROADMAP.md) the plan, item by item. Please file issues, or tell us what > broke on [Discord](https://discord.gg/artcraft). **Responsible use.** Use Craft Anything on software you own or are allowed to examine. It never bypasses DRM, logins or anti-cheat. Rebuilds recreate layout, style and behaviour from evidence; the agent is told not to copy logos, photos or text unless you confirm you own them or have permission. ## Downloads On GitHub, the [latest release](https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/releases/latest) has every build listed below, and [all releases](https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/releases) has earlier versions and their notes. `` in the file names is the version number, and `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists a checksum for every file. ### Windows | Build | Installer | Portable | |---|---|---| | x64 (64-bit Intel/AMD) | `craft-anything--windows-x64.msi` | `craft-anything--windows-x64-portable.zip` | | arm64 (Snapdragon and other ARM PCs) | `craft-anything--windows-arm64.msi` | `craft-anything--windows-arm64-portable.zip` | | x86 (32-bit) | `craft-anything--windows-x86.msi` | `craft-anything--windows-x86-portable.zip` | Installers and executables are code-signed. The portable zip keeps its settings next to the app. ### macOS | Build | File | Notes | |---|---|---| | App, universal (Apple silicon + Intel) | `craft-anything--macos-universal.dmg` | Signed and notarized | | Command-line tool, universal | `craft-anything-cli--macos-universal.zip` | Signed and notarized; see below if macOS blocks it | Versions after 0.2.0 include the command-line tool in the app, so builds don't need the separate zip. You only need it to use the command line without the app. A browser download of the zip can stop with "Apple could not verify craft-anything-cli" (a lone program can't carry its notarization with it, so macOS has to look it up online). A download from the terminal isn't checked this way, so use this instead: ```sh ver=0.2.0 # change this to the version you want curl -fLO "https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/releases/download/v$ver/craft-anything-cli-$ver-macos-universal.zip" ditto -x -k "craft-anything-cli-$ver-macos-universal.zip" . mkdir -p ~/.local/bin mv "craft-anything-cli-$ver-macos-universal/craft-anything-cli" ~/.local/bin/ ~/.local/bin/craft-anything-cli --version ``` To run it as just `craft-anything-cli`, add `~/.local/bin` to your `PATH`. If you already have the blocked copy, press Done (not Move to Bin), then run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine `, or allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway. ### Linux | Format | x86_64 | aarch64 (ARM64) | Notes | |---|---|---|---| | AppImage | `craft-anything--linux-x86_64.AppImage` | `craft-anything--linux-aarch64.AppImage` | Runs anywhere; updates itself with [AppImageUpdate](https://github.com/AppImageCommunity/AppImageUpdate) (`.zsync` files) | | Flatpak | `craft-anything--linux-x86_64.flatpak` | `craft-anything--linux-aarch64.flatpak` | Sandboxed; `flatpak install --user ` | | Debian/Ubuntu | `craft-anything--linux-x86_64.deb` | `craft-anything--linux-aarch64.deb` | | | Fedora/RHEL/openSUSE | `craft-anything--linux-x86_64.rpm` | `craft-anything--linux-aarch64.rpm` | | | Tarball | `craft-anything--linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | `craft-anything--linux-aarch64.tar.gz` | Unpack anywhere | RISC-V (riscv64): `craft-anything--linux-riscv64.tar.gz`, a tarball only. ### FreeBSD | Build | File | |---|---| | x86_64 | `craft-anything--freebsd-x86_64.tar.gz` | ### Web (WebAssembly) | Build | File | Notes | |---|---|---| | Browser viewer | `craft-anything-web-.zip` | Says what a file is, in the browser (the file never leaves it); host the folder on any static web server ([packaging/web/README.md](packaging/web/README.md)) |

Come make things with us

Our Discord is where artists of every kind hang out: people who paint, shoot, draw, cut film, set type, and people still figuring out what they like to make. items.readme:
简体中文 · English

DeepSeek Harness 的 Android 客户端。手机上直接跑，也能遥控你电脑上的 DSH。


Deepy 和鲸娘，陪你干活

干活时敲代码，做完来个空翻，等你确认会举手。打开「App 外显示」，它们还会跟你到桌面。


下载 DSH Go

从 GitHub Releases 或官网下载页获取最新版 APK，常见手机选 arm64 包。

 

感谢大家对 DSH Go 的支持和喜爱，我将尽快适配 iOS 和鸿蒙！大家 Star 点得越多，我适配得越快哦 hhh

第一次用可以先看使用指南，遇到问题欢迎来论坛和 QQ 群。
手机上装过签名不同的早期测试包时不能直接覆盖安装，需要先卸载旧版；卸载会清空对话、Linux 环境和设置。


本机运行，也能遥控电脑

内置 Linux 环境，免 Root、免 Termux。电脑上的 DSH，也能一键切过去接着用。


插话、打断，过程自动收好

回复中途也能插话，排队的消息随时「立即发送」。做完的过程折叠成一行。


原生界面，也有网页版

和官方网页版一键切换，停在同一段对话，下次打开还是你上次用的那个。


分享卡、对话回放和链接

回复一键做成分享卡。整段对话生成链接，对方在浏览器里回放，链接端到端加密。


横屏与平板

横屏手机和平板重新排版：侧栏常驻，内容居中，弹出键盘也不挤。


主题配色与桌面图标

六套主题色，也能跟随壁纸或自选颜色。四款桌面图标，三种功能图标风格。


中文，也说 English

全部界面支持英文，在设置里切换，默认跟随系统。


手机操控

看屏幕、帮你点，三档确认随你选。付款、密码和验证码，永远交还给你。


## 可以做什么 DSH Go 提供聊天界面、本机运行环境和远程连接，是基于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的第三方项目。运行在手机上的是 DSH 引擎；模型请求仍由你配置的模型提供方处理。 - **本机运行**：在 App 内安装 Ubuntu、Node.js 与 DSH 运行环境，无需 Root 或另装 Termux。 - **远程连接**：通过 SSH 或 DSH Remote 使用电脑、服务器上的 DSH。 - **聊天与工具**：切换模型，发送图片、使用语音输入，处理工具审批和提问；支持聊天界面与网页模式。 - **插件界面**：使用适配 DSH Go 的原生工具卡、表单和面板；仓库提供 SDK、教程和示例。 - **手机操控**：在你开启权限后，让本机引擎读取屏幕、点按和输入，并可随时停止。 - **分享与外观**：分享、导出和回放对话，调整主题、图标和桌宠。 功能随主机和连接方式不同。DSH Remote 当前只支持图片附件，不能在 App 内打开网页版，插件管理限于开关，且不支持 DS Bot 和对话日志导出。详见[本机引擎与远程主机](docs/guide/zh/03-engine-hosts.md)。 ## 安装 安装要求为 Android 8.0（API 26）及以上。Release 页面上的 **arm64** 安装包适用于常见的 64 位 Android 手机；x86_64 设备和模拟器用的 x64 包在发布说明末尾的「其他版本下载」里。仓库没有 32 位 ARM 构建。 1. 从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/releases/latest) 或[官网下载页](https://go.dshtui.com/download)下载对应架构的 APK，并按系统提示允许该安装来源。 2. 首次启动时，选择在本机安装运行环境，或连接远程主机。 3. 为所选主机配置模型和所需凭据，再开始对话；部分远程渠道需要在主机侧配置。 仅连接远程主机时，不必在手机上安装本机运行环境。手机操控只对正常模式下的本机引擎开放，需要按界面说明开启无障碍等权限；不打扰模式另外要求 Android 14 及以上，以及 Shizuku 或自连 ADB。首次使用可按[使用指南](docs/guide/README.md)逐项配置。 本地引擎默认使用 PRoot 兼容启动。开发者选项中的直接启动默认关闭，开启后的兼容性和回退方式见[常见问题](docs/guide/zh/11-faq.md)。当前 Android 构建以 APK 侧载为目标，不是 Google Play 发布配置。 ## 数据与权限 模型请求会发送给你配置的提供方。开启手机操控后，任务需要的屏幕文字可能发送给模型，支持看图的模型也可能收到截图；请先阅读 App 的权限说明。 “发送匿名使用统计”默认开启，可在首次引导或“设置 → 隐私与分享”关闭。采集范围和关闭后的处理见[常见问题](docs/guide/zh/11-faq.md)。分享内容前，请检查预览；收到链接或文件的人可以保存其中的内容。 ## 常见问题
和 DeepSeek 官方是什么关系？
没有关系。DSH Go 是社区开发的非官方客户端，基于开源的 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 构建。手机上运行的是 DSH 本身；模型请求发给你配置的模型提供方，需要联网，按你在提供方的账户计费。
安全吗？
本机网页版只接受 App 自己的访问。分享链接端到端加密，密钥只在链接里，服务器看不到内容。手机操控遇到付款、密码、验证码和系统设置，一律交还给你。
切到后台会被杀吗？
部分系统的省电策略会拦住后台。DSH Go 发现后会提醒你，并直达对应的放行设置，vivo、小米、华为、荣耀、OPPO 都有。
对手机有什么要求？
Android 8 及以上。手机直接下载 Release 页面上的安装包即可，模拟器用的 x86_64 版在发布说明末尾的「其他版本下载」里。在手机上运行 DSH 要先准备内置的运行环境，请预留约 1 GB 空间；只连电脑或服务器上的 DSH 可以不装。
开源吗？
开源，代码就在这个仓库，以 [AGPL-3.0](LICENSE) 发布，`sdk/` 和 `examples/` 为 MIT。DSH Go 的名称和标识，以及 Deepy、鲸娘两位吉祥物，不在开源授权范围内，见 [ASSETS.md](ASSETS.md)。
## 从源码构建 以下流程面向 **Linux x86_64**。当前工具链脚本默认安装 JDK 17、Flutter 3.47.7 和 Android SDK/NDK；App 要求 Dart `^3.13.5`。准备 Bash、Git、curl、tar、unzip、xz、Python 3、zstd（Python 未提供 `compression.zstd` 时用于解包 zstd 压缩的 deb）、file 和常见 GNU 命令；重新解析 Ubuntu 软件包锁时还需要 gpgv。 先取得完整源码和项目资源。`app/pubspec.yaml` 声明的字体、图片等都是构建输入，运行时包由下面的脚本生成。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go.git cd dsh-go bash tooling/setup-toolchain.sh source tooling/env.sh flutter --version java -version bash runtime/build-runtime.sh arm64-v8a DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh -f arm64 --keep-daemon ``` 工具链脚本会下载 SDK/NDK 与模拟器镜像，并执行 Android SDK 许可接受步骤。默认安装到 `~/dev`；可通过 `DEV_ROOT` 指定独立目录。脚本会复用已有安装，构建前请核对版本。 产物为 `app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-arm64-release.apk`。运行时构建使用仓库固定的版本与校验信息，并需要联网下载依赖。示例中的 `DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE=` 不嵌入维护者的内测通道令牌；`--keep-daemon` 保留 Gradle daemon，适合同时开发其他 Android 项目的环境。 构建 x86_64 包时，先生成对应运行时： ```bash bash runtime/build-runtime.sh x86_64 DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh -f x64 --keep-daemon ``` 未配置 `app/android/key.properties` 时，本地 release 构建使用 debug 签名。它不能直接覆盖不同签名的官方安装包；请在测试设备上安装，保留已有数据，不要为解决签名冲突直接卸载正在使用的 App。发布签名与密钥文件不要提交到仓库。 只查看 APK 构建命令，可运行： ```bash DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh --dry-run -f all ``` ## 目录 | 路径 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | `app/` | Flutter 界面与 Android Kotlin 平台实现 | | `packages/dsh_client/` | DSH Web API 的 Dart 客户端 | | `packages/dsh_remote/` | DSH Remote 的 Dart 客户端 | | `runtime/` | Linux 运行时打包、引擎补丁与 App 桥接 | | `sdk/plugin-kit/` | 原生插件作者工具包；在仓库中使用，未发布到 npm | | `examples/plugins/` | 插件示例 | | `docs/guide/`、`docs/plugins/` | 用户指南与插件开发文档 | | `docs/assets/` | 本页用到的展示图、桌宠动图和社群二维码 | | `tooling/` | 工具链、APK 构建与诊断脚本 | | `services/`、`site/`、`infra/` | 配套分享服务、网站和部署材料 | ## 参与贡献 问题反馈和改进建议可提交到 [Issues](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/issues)。代码、文档和翻译贡献请先看 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。插件作者可以从[插件教程](docs/plugins/README.md)和 [SDK](sdk/plugin-kit/README.md)开始。 安全问题请按 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) 报告，避免在公开 Issue 中提交漏洞细节或凭据。 ## 社区 - **论坛**：[forum.dshtui.com](https://forum.dshtui.com) - **QQ 群**：`1132118290`（[点此加群](https://qm.qq.com/q/OEy2RqZnqY)） - **微信群**：扫下方二维码，过期请加 QQ 群

  

QQ 群号 1132118290，电脑上可直接点此加群。微信群二维码每周更新，过期请加 QQ 群。

## 许可证与致谢 本项目采用 [AGPL-3.0](LICENSE)；`sdk/` 和 `examples/` 保持 **MIT**。第三方代码和素材以各自声明为准。 - [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)：DSH Go 运行和连接的就是它。 - [DSH-TUI](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI)：吉祥物 Deepy 小鲸鱼和鲸娘来自这里。 Phase 相关代码经作者许可使用。DeepSeek Harness、PiPilot、DS Bot、DSH Remote 及其他第三方组件、素材保留各自的许可证和署名。具体来源和条款见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。 DSH Go 的名称、标识、Deepy 小鲸鱼和鲸娘等形象不在 AGPL 授权范围内，使用条款见 [ASSETS.md](ASSETS.md)。 远程连接参考了 [ds-harness-remote](https://github.com/liguobao/ds-harness-remote) 的项目和服务器，感谢作者李国宝。

# dsh-superagent

> **Research prototype for reference only, not an official DeepSeek product.** This code grew out of our team's day-to-day development work, with much of the engineering done by coding agents. Treat it as research code, not production-ready software. It may still contain bugs, and its coding style and engineering practices may be inconsistent. Review and adapt it before using it in your own environment.
>
> We have adapted it for publication, so it is not identical to our internal version or the implementation described in *Exploring Super-agent Design: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System*. Some designs discussed in the article are directions for future development and are not implemented in this prototype.

dsh-superagent is a proactive coding agent for one GitHub repository, packaged as a bundle for [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/). It listens to GitHub and, optionally, Feishu. When someone allowed asks the agent for work, it opens a work item, works on it in its own agent session and directory, and answers in the original conversation, for example with a pull request. A web panel shows what needs a person.

It is also a way of working with an agent: **take as little human attention as possible, and give as much value as possible.** An agent that can act for a whole team can also waste a whole team's attention, so it acts only when asked or when a rule the team wrote allows it, and speaks only when someone must act or can use a result. [docs/000-philosophy.md](docs/000-philosophy.md) explains the principle and what it asks of the operator.

## Setup

Setup has many steps, so an agent does it with you. Ask your coding agent:

> Read SETUP.md in this repository and set up dsh-superagent with me.

It asks one short question at a time, shows the full plan once, and then installs and configures everything. [SETUP.md](SETUP.md) is what it follows.

## Documentation

Read the numbered documents in order; each builds only on the ones before it.

- [000 Philosophy](docs/000-philosophy.md)
- [001 Domain model](docs/001-domain.md)
- [002 Authorization](docs/002-authorization.md)
- [003 Execution](docs/003-execution.md)
- [004 Prompts](docs/004-prompts.md)
- [005 Panel](docs/005-panel.md)
- [006 Deployment](docs/006-deployment.md): manual setup, configuration, upgrades and troubleshooting
- [007 Architecture](docs/007-architecture.md)
- [008 Cookbook](docs/008-cookbook.md): adding a Source

## Development

`pnpm check` runs the typecheck, the tests and the build.

## License

# unslop

Created by Damir Sokolovsky ([@heydamir](https://x.com/heydamir)), who started the [Unslopping series](https://x.com/heydamir/status/2115063463063998736) on X.

![A vibecoded dashboard unslopping itself, frame by frame](skills/unslop/references/refs/story-dashboard-frames.webp)

unslop is a skill for Claude that turns vibecoded, AI-looking UI into a designed interface with its own character. It finds the slop first, the purple gradients, glows, emoji labels, shouty copy and uneven spacing, then sets a direction from your product and fixes the screen pass by pass like a designer doing a redline review. It works in whatever your screen is built with, like Next.js, React, Vue, Svelte, Tailwind or plain HTML and CSS, on dashboards, apps and landing pages, and even on a live site when all you have is a link.

## Install

For Claude Code, copy the skill into your skills folder.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/heydamir/unslop
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r unslop/skills/unslop ~/.claude/skills/
```

For a single project, copy it into `.claude/skills/` inside that project instead.

## Use

In Claude Code, type `/unslop` with what you want, or just ask in your own words and Claude picks the skill up by itself.

```
/unslop this dashboard
/unslop the hero of https://example.com
/unslop my landing page and make the story video so I can post it
```

It audits the screen and proposes a direction before it edits anything, so you can steer it early. If the screen is already good, it tells you so and suggests a few small refinements instead of redesigning it.

## What it does

- **Audit.** Lists every sign of slop with where it lives.
- **Direction.** Character, world, the one or two moments that carry the color, and a signature detail, all taken from your product.
- **Passes.** Spacing, color, icons, copy, type, layout, details, visuals and motion, in that order.
- **Visuals.** Shows your product instead of a glossy blob. When a hero needs a scene or an object, it can generate one through an image service like fal, Replicate, OpenAI images or Higgsfield. If none is connected, it offers to connect one as an MCP server, and it shows the prompt and asks before every paid generation. Dashboards and apps rarely need one.
- **Story video.** A square video under 10 seconds of your screen unslopping itself, ready to post. It needs Playwright and ffmpeg.

Try it on the two vibecoded screens in [examples](examples).

## Hire the unslopper

Would rather have a designer do it? Damir unslops one key screen in 3 days, built in your stack, at [heydamir.design/unslop](https://heydamir.design/unslop).

## License

| 🚀 [Download](#download) | ⚡ [Why switch](#why-switch-from-idm) | 🖼️ [Screenshots](#screenshots) | ✨ [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md) | 📜 [Help and tutorials](docs/README.md) | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | ## Why switch from IDM? **Same window you know. Your downloads finish sooner. And it costs nothing.**

| | Mister Download Manager | IDM 6.42 | | --- | --- | --- | | Download a big file (1 GB) | **1 second** | 5.5 seconds | | Download a small file | **instantly** | 3.1 seconds | | Download over a shaky connection | **1.6 seconds** | 5.4 seconds | | Wait before a download starts | **instantly** | 3.1 seconds | | Price | **Free, forever** | Paid, after a 30-day trial | | Ads, nag screens, sign-up | **None** | Registration needed | | Open source | **Yes** (GPL) | No | Nothing new to learn: the toolbar, the categories, the list of downloads, the progress window and the browser button are where you expect them. Measured on the same computer, same files, both programs at their default settings ([how we measured](#the-benchmark-in-detail)). ## Download

On the [download page](https://github.com/anefzaoui/misterdownloadmanager/releases/latest), pick one: | File | Choose it when | | --- | --- | | **`...-setup.exe`** | **Not sure? Take this one.** It installs MDM, connects it to your browser and asks your language. | | `...-portable.zip` | You want MDM on a USB stick or without installing: unzip and run. Everything stays in its folder. | | `...-x64.zip` | You want the plain programs without an installer. | | `...-extension-chromium.zip` | You want to add the browser extension by hand (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi). From the stores is easier: [Add to Chrome](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/mister-download-manager/ejoleppdfgjdndddcjoehopknmlglojp), [Add to Firefox](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/mister-download-manager/). | > [!NOTE] > Windows may say *"Windows protected your PC"* the first time, because this early version isn't > code-signed yet. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. Or with [WinGet](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/package-manager/winget/), Windows' package manager: in a terminal, the first line installs MDM and the second updates it. ``` winget install AhmedNefzaoui.MisterDownloadManager winget upgrade AhmedNefzaoui.MisterDownloadManager ``` ### On Linux MDM runs on Linux too, tested on Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 12 and Fedora with GNOME, KDE Plasma, Xfce and Cinnamon, on X11 and in Wayland sessions: the tray, dark mode, browser integration (Ubuntu's Snap Firefox included) and the packages' installs. Not there yet: screen readers (Orca) don't read its windows, and Flatpak browsers can't reach it ([more](docs/getting-started.md#on-linux)). Up to version 0.2.4, the files' names end in `-experimental`. | File | For | | --- | --- | | `...-linux-x86_64.deb` | Ubuntu, Debian, Mint, Pop!_OS: `sudo apt install ./.deb`. | | `...-linux-x86_64.rpm` | Fedora, openSUSE, RHEL: `sudo dnf install ./.rpm`. | | `...-linux-x86_64.AppImage` | Any Linux. Make it executable and run it. | | `...-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | The plain programs, for any distribution. |

### On a Mac? Be the first to try it Fresh builds for **macOS** (Apple Silicon and Intel) are on the same download page, marked `-experimental`: we haven't tried them on a Mac ourselves yet. Give them a go and [tell us how it went](https://github.com/anefzaoui/misterdownloadmanager/issues/new/choose); you'll help make them as solid as the Windows and Linux versions. | File | For | | --- | --- | | `...-macos-arm64-experimental.dmg` | Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or later). Open it and drag MDM to Applications. The first time, right-click the app and choose **Open**. | | `...-macos-x86_64-experimental.dmg` | Mac with an Intel processor, the same way. | ## 🌍 In your language Every language Windows 11 offers, **86 in all**. MDM asks on its first start, and you can change it any time in **View → Language**. Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Uyghur get a fully mirrored, right-to-left window.

## Screenshots

One click on YouTube: the Download video button appears over the video.
Any video on any page: drag the button where you like, it stays there.

Watch it fly: every connection's share of the file, live speed and time left.
Dark mode that follows Windows.

Add a download: paste a link, or let MDM catch it from your browser.
Torrents and magnet links: pick the files you want, skip the rest.

A torrent's progress: its files, peers, trackers and pieces, in tabs.
A video's progress: speed and time left while yt-dlp brings it in.

86 languages, chosen by flag on the first start.
Right to left for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Uyghur.

Download overnight: queues that start and stop on their own.
Options where you expect them, every control working.
## What it does - **Speeds up every download** by fetching parts of the file at the same time, and keeps re-balancing until the last byte. - **Resumes** after a crash, a restart or a dropped connection, without starting over. - **Catches downloads from Firefox, Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi and Helium** (the extension is on Firefox Add-ons and the Chrome Web Store), and gives them back to the browser when MDM isn't running. - **Downloads videos** from web pages (a button appears over the video; playlists, subtitles, the sound alone), **image galleries** with gallery-dl, and **torrents and magnet links** (sequential order, RSS feeds, sharing limits). - **Many links at once**: the Link grabber sorts them into packages and extracts the archives (zip, 7z, rar) when they're in. Debrid accounts (Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, Premiumize, TorBox; experimental) download file-host links through your own account. - **Downloads overnight** with queues and a scheduler that can wake the computer, then shuts it down if you like. - **Through your VPN only**, if you want: hold every download to one network adapter, with a kill switch, and choose an encrypted DNS. Each download shows its server's country. - **From your phone, or on a server**: control MDM from a phone on your home network, or run it without a window on a NAS (Docker, Unraid) ([how](docs/server.md)). - **Works from scripts too**: IDM's command-line switches, a command-line tool, and a local API for other programs ([how](docs/command-line.md)). - **Works with your AI assistant**: an MCP server lets Claude, Cursor or VS Code list, add, pause and remove your downloads ([set it up](docs/ai-assistants.md)). - **Leaves you some speed**: limit one download or all of them, only while you're at the computer. - **Day and dark mode, and themes**: Classic, Native, High contrast, Metro, Adwaita, Breeze, Luna, Aero and Aqua, or your own in a text file ([how](docs/themes.md)). Everything larger, up to 200 %, with **View → Interface size**. 86 languages, and a portable version for USB sticks. - **Works from the keyboard and with screen readers** (Narrator, NVDA): every window, dialog and menu ([the keys](docs/keyboard-shortcuts.md)). - **No ads, no trial, no account**. Free and open source. Step by step: [your first download](docs/guide-first-download.md) · [catch every browser download](docs/guide-catch-browser-downloads.md) · [download overnight](docs/guide-download-overnight.md) · [download a video](docs/guide-video-from-page.md) · [all help pages](docs/README.md) --- ## The benchmark in detail Both programs downloaded the same files from the same local test server ([labserver](crates/labserver)), with the network trouble each scenario names: seven runs each, both at their default settings. MDM finished first in **all seven scenarios**; every difference is statistically significant (Mann-Whitney p < 0.001), and MDM used less CPU in every one.

On a server that allows only two connections, MDM used 2 and still finished first; IDM opened 480. The full table, the machine and the raw data: [docs/bench/run5/REPORT.md](docs/bench/run5/REPORT.md). The harness is in [tools/bench](tools/bench), so anyone can run it again. ## Not a reverse-engineering project MDM is an independent, clean-room program. It is a new implementation of a familiar way of working, not a copy of anyone's software. - **No one else's code or assets.** It contains no code, binaries, artwork, icons, sounds or text from Internet Download Manager, nor code from any other download manager. The app icon was made for MDM with ChatGPT (OpenAI's image generation); the other icons come from openly licensed sets ([ATTRIBUTION.md](ATTRIBUTION.md)). - **Nothing taken apart.** No IDM file was ever disassembled, decompiled, debugged, patched or inspected below its user interface, and its licensing, trial and registration were never touched or bypassed. - **Learned as a user learns.** What MDM does was learned from IDM's public documentation and help pages, its public screenshots, and by using a licensed copy as a black box: downloading test files from our own test server ([labserver](crates/labserver)) and watching what reached the network and the screen. - **Built on public standards.** The download engine follows the HTTP specifications (RFC 9110, RFC 9112) and was designed, tested and measured independently. Its speed comes from its own design, which the benchmark shows. - **Not affiliated.** MDM isn't affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to Tonec Inc. "Internet Download Manager" and "IDM" are trademarks of their owner, named here only to describe the layout people already know and to compare the two programs. ## For developers
Build from source Requires Rust stable 1.98 or later (the MSVC toolchain on Windows), and for the engine's browser-like connection (BoringSSL, built from source): CMake, LLVM's libclang and, on Windows, NASM (`winget install Kitware.CMake LLVM.LLVM NASM.NASM`; on Linux `cmake` and `libclang-dev`; on macOS Xcode's command line tools and `cmake`). `cargo build -p mdm-app --no-default-features` builds the app without it (a site that refuses MDM's own connection then stays refused). ``` cargo build --release cargo test ``` This makes `misterdownloadmanager.exe` (the app), `misterdownloadmanager-cli.exe` (headless command line), `misterdownloadmanager-mcp.exe` (the MCP server for AI assistants) and `misterdownloadmanager-nmhost.exe` (the browser host) in `target\release\`. `tools\installer\build.ps1` builds the installer and both zips into `target\dist\` (needs [Inno Setup 6](https://jrsoftware.org/isinfo.php)); a `vX.Y.Z` tag does the same on GitHub Actions and publishes the release. Browser integration from a build: register the native messaging host with `target\release\misterdownloadmanager-nmhost.exe --register` (undo with `--unregister`), then in `chrome://extensions` or `edge://extensions` turn on Developer mode, **Load unpacked** and pick the `extension/` folder (its ID is always `oogbclbbninliongijffeeggalppliok`).
Layout and tools A Cargo workspace (edition 2024); [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) explains how the pieces fit. | Crate | What it is | |---|---| | [`mdm-engine`](crates/engine) | The download engine: segmentation, connections, resume, limits | | [`mdm-app`](crates/app) | The desktop app (egui), and `--headless` for servers | | [`mdm-cli`](crates/cli) | Headless downloads from the command line | | [`mdm-mcp`](crates/mcp) | The MCP server, for AI assistants | | [`mdm-nmhost`](crates/nmhost) | The browser's native messaging host | | [`mdm-ipc`](crates/ipc) | Talking to a running app; shared capture rules; the extension's IDs | | [`mdm-remote`](crates/remote) | The remote control: the HTTPS server and page a paired phone uses | | [`mdm-crash`](crates/crash) | Crash and freeze reports: the monitor, minidumps, stacks | | [`mdm-debrid`](crates/debrid) | Debrid accounts through the services' official APIs | | [`mdm-extract`](crates/extract) | Archive extraction (zip, tar, gz, xz; 7z and RAR through 7-Zip) | | [`mdm-geo`](crates/geo) | A server's country, from an IP table on this computer | | [`mdm-tools`](crates/tools) | yt-dlp and ffmpeg for video pages, gallery-dl for galleries | | [`mdm-torrent`](crates/torrent) | BitTorrent through librqbit | | [`mdm-labserver`](crates/labserver) | An HTTP test server with fault injection, for tests and benchmarks | | Tool | What it does | |---|---| | `tools\dev\check-cross.ps1` | Checks the code for Linux and macOS from Windows (with [Zig](https://ziglang.org) as the C compiler) | | `node tools/extension/e2e.mjs` | The browser extension in real Chrome, Brave, Edge and Firefox, headless: a link's download must reach MDM (or another MDM, a server); on Windows and Linux | | `python tools/i18n/extract.py` | Lists every interface text in `i18n/en.tsv` (CI checks it matches the code) | | `python tools/i18n/translate.py` | Translates what the catalogs lack (checks every row in code) | | `python tools/installer/languages.py` | The installer's messages in every language | | `node tools/readme/build.mjs` | This page's pictures, comparison table and flags, from the benchmark data | | `tools\lab\docs-shots.ps1` | The screenshots, from a separate test instance (`/show ` opens each window), off the screen | | `python tools/shots/make.py` | The help pages' pictures, from one list (`tools/shots/shots.toml`): shot, cropped, annotated, lossless WebP; `make.py check` keeps them in step | | `tools/lab/wsl/` | A WSL2 machine that builds MDM for Linux in minutes and shoots its windows on a virtual screen ([README](tools/lab/wsl/README.md)) | | `tools\lab\progress-shots.ps1` | The progress window of a video (yt-dlp) and of a torrent, from a swarm on this computer (`cargo run -p mdm-torrent --example swarm`) | | `python tools/website/build.py --serve` | misterdownloadmanager.com into `target/site` (help pages from `docs/`, news from the CHANGELOG, FAQ and legal pages from `website/content/`), served on http://127.0.0.1:8765; items.name: Leonida
items.description: Leonida Is A Native PC Recompilation Of The Xbox Version Of Grand Theft Auto 6
items.readme:
Leonida

Grand Theft Auto VI (Xbox Series) running natively on Windows, built on your PC from your own copy.

Status | How to build | How it works | Want to help? | Credits | License | Discord

Leonida is a static recompilation project. The Xbox Series CPU is x86-64 like a PC, so the game's code is loaded and run natively, and the console's system software is reimplemented. The console's precompiled RDNA2 GPU programs are translated to SPIR-V for Vulkan. The game's models, textures and audio are read from your package. All of this happens **on your PC, from your own copy of the game**. > [!IMPORTANT] > This repository **does not contain the game, keys or an executable**, and it does not explain how to get them. You > need your own copy, with its files already readable on disk. Nothing here decrypts or works around any protection. > Everything the build creates (the generated shaders, extracted assets, the runtime folder and your saves) comes > from your game and stays on your PC. Never share those files. Discord: https://discord.gg/rexed
## Project status **Early. The game does not boot yet.** Everything that can be done without the game's executable is in place, so work on booting can start as soon as one is available to a developer. | What | Status | |---|---| | Finding and checking your copy (Xbox Series 1.0.2.1) | ✅ Works | | Shaders: carve, unpack native RDNA2 code, disassemble | ✅ All 26,503 | | Shaders: RDNA2 → SPIR-V translation | ✅ **All 26,503**: 2,236 VS, 12,101 PS, 2,689 CS, 9,282 mesh, 195 geometry. All pass `spirv-val`, with a per-shader metadata index for pipeline creation. ⚠️ 21,545 are wave64: exact on 64-wide subgroups (AMD), and cross-half wave ops are approximate on 32-wide (NVIDIA) | | Shader translator checked on a real GPU | ⚠️ Vertex fetch, texture sampling, exports, ALU ops, partial-register ops, barycentrics, wave-uniform branches and compute (LDS, barriers, buffer stores) checked on one GPU | | Models (OBJ with real names, UVs, material references) | ✅ Exported. Not all layouts are decoded yet | | Texture dictionaries and world texture pools (DDS) | ✅ Exported. Some pool entries (BCPack) are skipped | | Audio banks (AWC: Opus, XMA2) | ✅ Exported whole. Opus repackaged **losslessly** as Ogg Opus; PCM (codec 0/2) as WAV; XMA2 decoded with ffmpeg. `--wav` adds 16-bit PCM WAV ([notes](docs/audio.md)) | | Music/radio config | ? Measured. **1,589** audio-config records with exact durations and AWC stream ids; station grouping and content-id lists; no per-track start offsets ([notes](docs/audio_config.md)) | | PE loader and import shims | ⚠️ Skeleton. Untested against the real executable | | Xbox D3D12 → Vulkan | ⚠️ In progress. A Vulkan-backed device behind the Xbox-ABI proxy creates queues, command lists, fences, descriptor heaps, views and committed resources; barriers, clears, uploads and copies (BC included) run on Vulkan, checked on one GPU. No shader views, pipelines, draws or swapchain yet ([plan](docs/d3d12_vulkan.md)) | | Booting, story mode, anything playable | ❌ No | ## How to build The port isn't downloaded ready-made. It's built on your PC from your own copy. **The easy way:** 1. Install the prerequisites below. 2. Download this project **with its submodule**: `git clone --recursive https://github.com/ItsNotRexed/Leonida`. A "Download ZIP" from GitHub leaves out `third_party/rpf9-explorer`. The build fetches it if `git` is installed, and otherwise tells you what to do. 3. Double-click **`Build.bat`**. It finds your copy of the game by itself: it looks in Downloads, Desktop, Documents, Games, your home folder and the top of every drive, two folders deep. It recognises the version from a few file sizes, without reading anything large. If you have more than one copy it asks which one, and if it finds none it asks you to paste the folder. Before starting it checks that everything below is installed and that there is enough free space, and it lists anything missing in one go. The result goes to `Documents\Leonida`. A stopped build continues where it left off. Your game folder is the one that holds `MicrosoftGame.Config` and the `.rpf` archives, as plain files. **Prerequisites:** - **Your own copy** of the Xbox Series package, version 1.0.2.1. - **Windows 10/11 x64**, with about **350 GB** free for work files. They can go on another drive with `--work`. - [Python 3.11+](https://www.python.org/downloads/) (tick "Add python.exe to PATH"). - [.NET 8 SDK](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0). - [Vulkan SDK](https://vulkan.lunarg.com/), for `spirv-as` / `spirv-val`. - [LLVM 21+](https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/releases) with the **AMDGPU target** for `llvm-mc`. The official Windows build has no AMDGPU target. On Windows, `scripts\build_llvm_mc.ps1` builds a native `llvm-mc.exe` with it (no WSL; needs git and the Visual Studio C++ tools below) and sets `LLVM_MC`. Or install `llvm-21` in WSL and set `LLVM_MC` to the whole command, `LLVM_MC="wsl -d Ubuntu -e /usr/lib/llvm-21/bin/llvm-mc"` (see [docs/design.md](docs/design.md#disassembling-shaders)). On Linux, `llvm-mc` on PATH is enough. - Visual Studio 2022 with **Desktop development with C++**, for the runtime stage. - [ffmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org/download.html) on PATH (optional: decodes the XMA2 streams, and required for `--wav`). **From a terminal**, with the same behaviour and more control: ```powershell python -I make_game.py --find # list the copies found on this PC python -I make_game.py --check # check your copy, build nothing python -I make_game.py --game "D:\path\to\your\package" --out "D:\Games\Leonida" --work "E:\leonida-work" python -I make_game.py --stages shaders,assets # only some stages python -I make_game.py --game "D:\path\to\your\package" --wav # also decode Opus to PCM WAV (large) ``` Stages run in order: `check`, `shaders`, `assets`, `runtime`, `pipelines` (creates every translated shader on your GPU driver and saves a pipeline cache, so the first boot doesn't compile them). The shader translation is the longest step: it runs on `--jobs` processes (half the CPU threads by default). `--wav` is off by default because 16-bit PCM WAV is several times larger than Ogg Opus. It decodes the repackaged Ogg Opus streams to `work\assets\audio\wav` after the audio bank step; existing WAV files are skipped when a build resumes. ### Vulkan diagnostics on Linux With CMake 3.24+, a C++20 compiler, and Vulkan development headers and loader installed: ```sh cmake -S runtime -B runtime/build/linux cmake --build runtime/build/linux --parallel ./runtime/build/linux/vk_pipeline_check /path/to/spirv ``` Pass the directory containing `index.json` and the translated SPIR-V files to `vk_pipeline_check`. ## How it works | Piece | What it does | Where | |---|---|---| | Version check | Every package file's name, size and SHA-256 for each supported version | `game/`, `make_game.py` | | Shader pipeline | Carves DXBC containers from `shaders.rpf` without its encrypted table of contents. Unpacks the `XBCH` → `FSSM` native RDNA2 program, disassembles it with LLVM (`gfx1013`) and translates it to SPIR-V | `tools/shader_carve.py`, `fssm_unpack.py`, `shader_disasm.py`, `rdna2spirv.py` | | Asset export | Finds validated resources inside RPF9 archives and the loose `.ttpf` texture pools | `tools/rpf9dump` (on rpf9-explorer's Core) | | Runtime | Maps the PE image, resolves imports to shims (GDK, XMem, `d3d12_xs`) | `runtime/` | | Research tools | PE/RTTI inspection, raw carving, texture tiling probes, GPU test harnesses | `tools/`, `runtime/test/` | The translator's runtime contract (user SGPRs, push constants, memory model, bindless images, vertex fetch, system values) and all the format notes are in [docs/design.md](docs/design.md); the format, asset, runtime and validation notes are indexed in [docs/README.md](docs/README.md). The Xbox D3D12 plan is in [docs/d3d12_vulkan.md](docs/d3d12_vulkan.md). Audio bank formats and the export tools are in [docs/audio.md](docs/audio.md); [docs/related_projects.md](docs/related_projects.md) records the prior art we may read and the licence limits on it. ## Want to help? The biggest open pieces: - **Compute, mesh and geometry shaders**: their per-stage system-value register layout. - **Xbox D3D12 → Vulkan**: the `d3d12_xs` command list and descriptor heap model. - **Model layouts** the decoder rejects today. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Never attach game files, extracted assets or generated shaders to issues or pull requests. ## Credits - [rpf9-explorer](https://github.com/breadbbbb/rpf9-explorer) by breadbbbb: the RPF9 model, texture-pool and AWC decoders used by `tools/rpf9dump` (git submodule). - [Mesa](https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/mesa/mesa) (MIT): GFX10 resource-descriptor layout (`tools/gfx10_formats.json`), and the ACO/RADV rules used as reference for 16-bit results and shader system registers. - [LLVM](https://llvm.org/): AMDGPU disassembler. - Logo: ["Grand Theft Auto VI" icon by SlyDevil](https://www.steamgriddb.com/icon/122618) on SteamGridDB. - [SPIRV-Tools](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/SPIRV-Tools): assembly and validation. Grand Theft Auto and all related names are trademarks of their owners. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by them. ## License GPLv3 (or any later version). See [LICENSE](LICENSE). Third-party code keeps its own license.

items.name: kiri
items.description: A small, fast container runtime for macOS, Windows and Linux with free Ngrok alternative
items.readme:
A tiny, fast container runtime for macOS, Windows and Linux.
Runs your Docker images and works with the docker CLI, Compose and buildx you already use.

Download · Features · Build from source · Releases

--- Kiri is a lightweight replacement for Docker Desktop and OrbStack, written in Rust. It runs containers in one small Linux VM (or straight on the kernel on Linux) and speaks the Docker Engine API, so your tools just work. The name comes from the Igbo word *ntakịrị*, "small". ## Why Kiri - **Fast**: a container starts and exits in about 2.5 ms through the Docker API. That's around 80 times faster than Docker Desktop. - **Light**: the VM sleeps after 60 s idle, the daemon stays at about 15 MB, and it wakes in about 0.15 s. - **Compatible**: `docker`, Compose, buildx, `docker login` and amd64 images through Rosetta. - **Local domains**: `http://.kiri.local`, with HTTPS from Kiri's own certificate authority. - **More than containers**: a one-command Kubernetes cluster and Linux machines. - **A native window** for containers, images, volumes and networks, plus a menu bar item. ## Install | Platform | Get it | |----------|--------| | macOS 14+ (Apple silicon or Intel) | `.dmg` from [runkiri.com/releases](https://runkiri.com/releases/) | | Windows 10 and 11 (x86-64 or Arm, through WSL 2) | `.msi` from [runkiri.com/releases](https://runkiri.com/releases/) | | Linux (Ubuntu, Fedora and others) | `.deb` or `.rpm` from [runkiri.com/releases](https://runkiri.com/releases/) | The first time you open Kiri, it sets up a `kiri` Docker context. Kiri updates itself, and checks each new release's signature first. ## Quick start ```sh docker --context kiri run --rm alpine echo hello docker --context kiri compose up -d kiri k8s start # single-node Kubernetes as the `kiri` kubectl context kiri machine create dev --distro ubuntu && kiri machine shell dev kiri import # bring images, volumes and containers over from OrbStack or Docker Desktop ``` Docker's commands also work as `kiri` commands (`kiri run`, `kiri ps`, `kiri compose up`, and so on), and always target Kiri. ## Numbers `alpine` running `true` and removed, median of 30 runs, same `docker` CLI for all three: | | Docker Engine API | `docker` CLI | |----------------|------------------:|-------------:| | **Kiri** | **2.55 ms** | **14.2 ms** | | Docker Desktop | 213 ms | 243 ms | | OrbStack | 380 ms | 442 ms | Method and every other figure are in [`bench/results.json`](bench/results.json). Rerun with `kiri bench`. ## How it works ``` docker CLI ─┐ compose ────┼─ Docker Engine API ─► kiri daemon ── vsock ──► guest agent (PID 1) buildx ─────┤ owns the VM clone3 → container kiri UI ────┘ ``` The VM uses a custom 10 MB kernel, and its PID 1 is a ~900 KB Rust agent. That agent starts containers with a single `clone3` into namespaces and a cgroup. There's no runc, no shim and no dockerd. More detail is in [docs/development.md](docs/development.md#architecture). ## Documentation - [Features](docs/features.md): everything supported today, release files and known issues - [Development](docs/development.md): building, running from source, architecture and repository layout - [Release notes](docs/releases) ## Roadmap Next is a built-in builder. Kiri will serve Docker's own build endpoints, so buildx uses its docker driver against Kiri as it does against Docker Desktop. This brings `host-gateway` support to BuildKit builds, and images load straight into Kiri. ## Contributing Issues and pull requests are welcome. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). To report a vulnerability privately, see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). ## License [Apache-2.0](LICENSE). Third-party licences are in [NOTICE](NOTICE). The guest kernel is Linux (GPL-2.0); its config, patches and the source offer are in [`guest/kernel`](guest/kernel). The name "Kiri" and the Kiri logo are not covered by the licence. Forks are welcome, under a different name and logo.

items.readme:
Reverse-engineer any video. Shot by shot: was it filmed, AI-generated or coded, and how to remake it. Every breakdown is written in **[VIDEO.md](https://videomd.github.io/videomd/)**, an open format that agents read layer by layer. [Website](https://www.reavideo.ai) | [中文](i18n/README_zh.md) | English | [Русский](i18n/README_ru.md) | [日本語](i18n/README_ja.md) | [한국어](i18n/README_ko.md) | [Español](i18n/README_es.md) | [Português](i18n/README_pt.md) | [Français](i18n/README_fr.md) | [Deutsch](i18n/README_de.md) | [Tiếng Việt](i18n/README_vi.md) | [বাংলা](i18n/README_bn.md) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/JuneYaooo/rea-video?style=flat)](https://github.com/JuneYaooo/rea-video/stargazers) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-%E2%89%A53.10-blue) ![Agent](https://img.shields.io/badge/runs%20in-Claude%20Code%20%7C%20Codex-8A2BE2) [![Output: VIDEO.md](https://img.shields.io/badge/output-VIDEO.md-3d4fd6)](https://videomd.github.io/videomd/) [![Visit our website](https://img.shields.io/badge/Visit%20our%20website-6644D8?style=for-the-badge)](https://www.reavideo.ai) [![Join our Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Join%20our%20Discord-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/dZj8D3GqWT) [![WeChat group](https://img.shields.io/badge/WeChat%20group-07C160?style=for-the-badge&logo=wechat&logoColor=white)](i18n/README_zh.md#社区) [![Follow on X](https://img.shields.io/badge/Follow%20%40yao__june12106-000000?style=for-the-badge&logo=x&logoColor=white)](https://x.com/yao_june12106) ⭐ *Help more people find rea-video. Star this repo!* Left: a TikTok ad shot on a phone. Right: an AI remake with another product. rea-video's verdict: the left is all live footage, one set and two camera positions; the right is all AI, 8 shots across 3 generations.
## Quick start rea-video is built for AI agents. In Claude Code, Codex or any agent that can run commands, say: ```text Install https://github.com/JuneYaooo/rea-video, then break down this video: /path/to/video.mp4 ``` The agent installs the CLI, learns the workflow and runs the whole thing. You need ffmpeg and Python 3.10+. Breakdowns are fully upgraded. Each one gives you two outputs: - **Report** (`report.html` / PDF), for you: more reader-friendly, with a clearer structure, easier to learn from and to understand how the video was made and how to remake it. - **[VIDEO.md](https://videomd.github.io/videomd/)**, for your AI: layered, so the AI reads only what a question needs and uses fewer tokens. You can also hook up a video-capable model (Gemini or Doubao both work) by giving the agent its endpoint and key. That makes the live/AI/3D calls more accurate and adds a reverse-engineered prompt for every shot. It works fine without one; if your agent can see images, it checks the uncertain shots itself. > Reports are written in whichever language you ask in (Chinese or English). The example reports below are in English. ## What it can break down | Video type | Examples | What you get | |---|---|---| | Live footage | Talking-head, tabletop, handheld product demo, vlog, store visit | Setups and camera positions, framing, camera moves, lighting (12 setups with gear lists), color grade | | AI video | Text/image-to-video, AI short drama, AI music video | Evidence, a reverse-engineered prompt per shot, how to batch into generations and which model to use | | Avatar | A portrait driven by audio, lip-sync | Which shots are avatar shots, what portrait and audio you need | | 3D / animation | Blender / C4D explainers, product animation, 2D animation, stop-motion | Whether to generate with a video model or render from 3D code | | Code / template | Kinetic type, UI demos, charts, slide-style cards | Text, layout and motion timing, ready to rebuild as a Remotion project | | Screen recording | Software tutorials, web demos | Which parts are real material you'll need to record yourself | | Mixed / edits | AI characters + code UI + real screen capture; live footage with AI edits | Each shot judged separately, then reassembled on the original timeline | Besides how the visuals were made, every breakdown also covers: - Captions and styled text: start and end of each line (exports to SRT / ASS), plus color, outline and how the text comes in - Stickers, emoji, picture-in-picture: where they sit and how long they stay - Editing: where the cuts are, how fast, whether they hit the beat - Audio: human or AI voice, AI or library music and its BPM, where each sound effect lands - Material you'll need to supply yourself: screen recordings, screenshots, product photos ## Examples The sample videos in `docs/cases/videos/` are re-compressed to keep the repo small, which strips the TikTok / Douyin platform tags. So if you run them yourself, you'll get different results from the reports below, especially without a vision model. To reproduce them, use the original downloads from the platform.

Mixed-media clip · 19 s · 10 shots
AI characters talking + code-built UI + 8 s of real screen recording. The 5 dialogue shots are broken up by UI segments but share one set, so a single generation covers all of them.
Video · Report
3D explainer · 67 s · 21 shots
All 3D, AI narration. You can do it in 10 video generations, or have an LLM write Blender / Three.js code.
Video · Report

Product promo · 70 s · 12 shots
83% code-driven motion graphics, 12% screen recording. No video model needed; one Remotion project does it.
Video · Report
AI music video · 165 s · 86 shots
Correctly flags the song as AI-generated (it was made with Suno). The vision model called some shots "live-action drama"; the agent spotted fake Chinese characters on a scroll and ruled them AI.
Video · Report

Live-action unboxing · 72 s · 29 shots
All real footage: an overhead phone rig, one rug, one camera position, no voice-over, room sound plus library BGM. After platform transcoding, the offline tools called 35% of it AI; after agent review it came out 97% live-action.
Video · Report
## Remakes After rea-video breaks a video down, the remake recipe in [capsule-cinema](https://github.com/JuneYaooo/capsule-cinema) generates a new version that keeps the original's camera, motion, pacing and transitions and swaps only the elements you pick. These were made with a self-hosted MiniMax H3, using the original shot as the motion reference and keyframes with the swapped elements (gpt-image-2) for the look. Below are three remakes OiiOii showed in its WeChat articles. We made two versions of each: one with the same swap as OiiOii, and one that also swaps the subject, setting and props. Each GIF plays four versions in sync: the original, OiiOii's remake, our remake and the element-swap version.
Overhead outfit change · 12 s
Same swap: woman → man, three outfits → matching menswear. Element swap: a girl in three historical Hanfu outfits in a Chinese study; the remote becomes a round fan.

HD comparison video (with audio) · same-moment stills
Paper-craft / watercolor animation · 30 s
Same swap: new clay girl as the lead. Element swap: a fox; forest → coral reef, clouds → starry sky, sunset → aurora.

HD comparison video (with audio) · same-moment stills
Handheld product video · 21 s · 11 shots
Same swap: an original new product, English sticker → Chinese caption. Element swap: pink product, kitchen → camping table, new ingredients.

HD comparison video (with audio) · same-moment stills
The HD comparison videos use the original audio. The originals and OiiOii versions come from the articles and are shown for comparison only. You can also do the remake in [ChatCut](https://chatcut.io/r/github-e4rd), a hosted AI video editor: there is no model to set up, and the generated shots land on a timeline you can keep editing. Sponsor ## Sponsors rea-video is free and open source. Sponsors help keep it maintained.
ChatCut is an AI video editor for Claude Code and Codex that generates the shots, cuts them on a timeline and exports the finished video.
Try ChatCut for free
Sponsored · Become a sponsor ## Accuracy Accuracy of the how-it-was-made call, weighted by shot duration: | | Tuning set (15) | Holdout (16) | Re-encoded WeChat videos (10) | |---|---|---|---| | Tools only (offline, free) | 98.3% | 99.6% / 98.9% | 88.6% | | + vision model (Gemini) | — | 99.6% / 99.8% | 99.6% | | + agent visual review | — | 99.6% / 99.8% | 100% | The Holdout column shows two numbers: holdout (9 videos) and holdout2 (7 videos). On original files, the tools alone are usually enough. Videos downloaded from platforms have been recompressed, which wipes out the noise evidence, so you need a visual check to get back above 99%. Real-asset detection is 97–99%; on nine hand-labelled clips, shot boundaries reach 95% recall and 94% precision. Numbers and how to reproduce them: [eval/RESULTS.md](eval/RESULTS.md). ## How it works ![rea-video pipeline](docs/rea-flow_en.svg) 1. Split: cut the video into shots and split the audio into voice, music and effects. 2. Gather evidence: measure (frame cadence, sensor noise, whether the whole image moves as one flat plane, AIGC tags in the metadata), look (hands, text, physics) and listen (BPM, key, singing vs speech). 3. Decide: hard evidence like AIGC tags and frame cadence beats "looks like". Conflicts get flagged for the agent to check visually. 4. Plan the remake: batch shots according to what the target video model can actually do, such as max clip length, multi-shot support and how many reference images it takes. ## Star History [![Star History Chart](https://api.star-history.com/svg?repos=JuneYaooo/rea-video&type=Date)](https://star-history.com/#JuneYaooo/rea-video&Date) ## FAQ
How is this different from one-click remake tools like Hypit? [Hypit](https://github.com/hypit-ai/hypit) takes a reference video and makes a new one: the agent reads frame grids to understand the original, generates footage with the models it supports (Seedance, PixVerse, MiniMax, Wan and others), and renders captions and motion graphics in HTML. It doesn't ask how the original was made. A live-action source goes through the same pipeline; it won't tell you how many cameras were used or how it was lit. What AI video it can match depends on the models it supports: no Kling or Veo, no dedicated avatar or 3D path, and no AI music (you bring your own). It's strongest on talking-head, podcast and interview videos that follow a script, and weaker on music-driven edits, product motion graphics and cinematic shorts. rea-video doesn't render a video. It works out shot by shot whether something was filmed, AI-generated or built in code, then gives a shooting plan, prompts or a code approach for each. For a quick lookalike, Hypit is faster. To understand how the original was made and remake it cheaply, use rea-video. They work fine together.
Do I need a video-capable model? What does it cost? No. Tools-only mode is offline and free, and already accurate on original files. For recompressed platform downloads, add a video-capable model (Gemini or Doubao both work) or use an agent that can see images; you pay whatever that service charges. Automatic video generation (capsule-cinema) does a free dry run first and only calls paid models after you confirm.
Can it remake the whole video automatically? Partly. With [capsule-cinema](https://github.com/JuneYaooo/capsule-cinema) installed, AI shots are generated and placed back on the original timeline automatically. You film the live shots from the shooting plan, and the agent writes the code shots as a Remotion project. See [docs/replicate.md](docs/replicate.md).
Can it break down a multi-episode short drama? rea-video works on one video at a time. For multi-episode short dramas with a running story, see [rea-toon](https://github.com/JuneYaooo/rea-toon).
What is VIDEO.md, and why does rea-video write one? Every skill has a `SKILL.md`; every video gets a `VIDEO.md`. It is an open format for video breakdowns, made so that models read only what a question needs. A full breakdown runs to hundreds of thousands of tokens; VIDEO.md lays it out in levels: a card of a few hundred tokens, an overview and map, a timeline with one line per shot, then one file per shot. Every file states its size, and what is seen on screen is kept apart from what the tools infer. rea-video writes one into every output folder (`out/ref/VIDEO.md`), and its agent skill reads it instead of the raw data. Other agents and tools can read it without knowing rea-video: `pip install videomd`, then `videomd check out/ref`. The spec and guides are at [videomd.github.io/videomd](https://videomd.github.io/videomd/).
Can I just repost someone else's video? No. rea-video is for learning a video's structure, pacing and techniques, then remaking it with material you have the rights to. Don't reuse other people's footage, music, characters or likeness. Follow platform rules and local AI-content labeling requirements when you publish.
## Docs - [docs/what-it-detects.md](docs/what-it-detects.md): everything it detects (10 visual types, camera, lighting, grade, audio) - [docs/replicate.md](docs/replicate.md): how to remake from the report - [docs/cases.md](docs/cases.md): details on each example - [docs/decompose.md](docs/decompose.md): detection rules - [docs/cli.md](docs/cli.md): CLI usage and capsule-cinema integration - [docs/videomd.md](docs/videomd.md): VIDEO.md, the standard breakdown package that agents and downstream tools read (open format: [videomd/videomd](https://github.com/videomd/videomd)) - [rea_video/capabilities/](rea_video/capabilities/README.md): capability tables for video / image / audio models, used to pick models for the remake plan - [eval/RESULTS.md](eval/RESULTS.md): eval results The docs are in Chinese for now. ## Community Questions, breakdowns and remake ideas: [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/JuneYaooo/rea-video/discussions). Chat with us on [Discord](https://discord.gg/dZj8D3GqWT). Chinese speakers can also find us on [linux.do](https://linux.do/). Want a video broken down? Open a [request issue](https://github.com/JuneYaooo/rea-video/issues/new?template=request_breakdown.yml) with the link and we'll publish the result as a case. ## Credits Inspired by [REA (Reverse Engineer Anything)](https://github.com/morluto/rea): work back from what you see to how it was made, back every claim with evidence, and verify by measuring. Sound separation uses [UVR MDX-Net](https://github.com/TRvlvr/model_repo) for voice and music, and [BandIt v2](https://github.com/kwatcharasupat/bandit-v2) (Watcharasupat, Wu and Orife; weights CC BY-SA 4.0) for sound effects. Both models are downloaded on first use and are not part of this repo.

# Agent skills from Jane Street

A collection of skills for AI agents and chatbots.
Each skill is a directory containing a `SKILL.md` file
with instructions for the agent.

## Skills

- **socratic-tutor** — turns an LLM into a strict personal tutor that teaches a
  topic of your choice using the Socratic method: a diagnostic, a skill map with
  levels 0-5, one question at a time, spaced review, and a final assessment.

## How to use

With a coding agent that supports the common `SKILL.md` format, copy the skill
directory into your agent's skills folder, then ask the agent to use it
("teach me X").

With a plain chatbot, paste the body of the skill's `SKILL.md` into the chat
(or into a custom/system prompt), followed by what you want it to do.

Mika

简体中文 · [English](README.en.md) **你手机上的私人 AI 助理，替你操作 App、上网、把事办成。**
它在一块看不见的后台屏上干活，你照样刷你的手机。

⬇ 下载 Mika（安卓 APK）

[安装](#安装) · [快速开始](#快速开始) · [能做什么](#能做什么) · [常见问题](#常见问题) · [参与贡献](#参与贡献)
## 安装 **方式一：在手机上自己装** 1. 从 [Releases](https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/releases/latest) 下载最新的 APK，安装。 2. 打开 Mika 设置里的「设置手机操作」向导，配对一次无线调试（[设置指南](docs/setup-guide.md)）。 3. 在设置里的「模型」添加服务商、填 API Key，或者用 ChatGPT、xAI、OpenRouter 账号登录。 每一步的细节见下文的[快速开始](#快速开始)。 **方式二：让电脑上的 AI 助手帮你装** 手机用数据线连上电脑，在手机上打开 USB 调试（开发者选项里别的开关不要动，除非 AI 助手请你打开；有的会清除手机数据），然后把下面这句话发给电脑上能执行命令的 AI 助手： ``` 请按 https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/blob/main/docs/install-with-agent.md 的步骤，帮我把 Mika 安装到通过 USB 连着的安卓手机上。 ``` 它会检查手机、下载安装、打开需要的权限，需要你在手机上点的时候会停下来告诉你。API Key 由你自己在 Mika 里填，不经过它。 **装好之后：让电脑上的 AI 工具直接用 Mika（MCP）** 手机用数据线连着电脑，在电脑上运行： ``` adb shell sh /sdcard/Android/data/com.wangzan101.mika/files/connect-computer.sh adb forward tcp:8765 tcp:8765 ``` 第一条会打开 Mika 的电脑连接，并打印连接信息（地址 `http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp` 和令牌）；把它们填进电脑上 AI 工具的 MCP 配置，它就能给 Mika 派任务、查进度、拿结果。手机上不用点；只经数据线连接、要令牌，Wi-Fi 上连不到；付款这类确认只能在手机上点。用方式二安装时，AI 助手会顺手帮你接好。详见[电脑连接说明](docs/mcp.md)。 > **English summary** > > Mika is an Android app that takes a one-sentence request and carries it out on your phone. It drives apps on a private background screen (so you can keep using your phone), browses the web in a built-in desktop-class browser, and runs scripts in a local Linux sandbox. You bring your own model API key (several providers are supported as presets, plus any OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, Gemini or OpenAI Responses endpoint). There is no Mika server: your requests go only to the model provider you configure. > > Status: **public beta**, changing quickly (see [Releases](https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/releases) for versions and changes). Chat, web and sandbox tasks work on Android 11+; phone app control needs Android 12+, with Android 14+ recommended. The sandbox runs on arm64 devices only. The app UI is available in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English (follows your system language; switch in Settings › Language); see the [full English README](README.en.md). Licensed under Apache-2.0. ## Beta 说明 - 这是早期公开测试版，功能和界面还在快速变化，升级时可能有不兼容的改动。 - 目前主要在一台安卓 14 手机上测试过。别的安卓版本、别的手机上可能遇到没见过的问题，欢迎[反馈](#参与贡献)。 - Mika 会替你操作第三方 App 和网站，请先读[免责声明](#免责声明)。 ## 演示


后台发微信：左边是 Mika 的对话页，右边是 Mika 在后台屏上的每一步
（加速 4 倍；聊天列表已打码）


后台翻完微信群，总结今天聊了啥
（加速播放；总结正文涉及群友发言，已打码）
打开小红书，总结一位博主的内容
（加速播放）
在 BOSS 直聘网页上给 3 个岗位打招呼
（加速播放）

打开 Hacker News，读出首页前 5 条和分数
（加速 1.5 倍）
在 Google Flights 上找旧金山到纽约最便宜的直飞
（加速 3 倍；价格按网络所在地区显示为港币）
在 Amazon 上找 30 美元以内、4.5 星以上的 USB-C 充电器，加进购物车，停在结账前
（加速 3.5 倍）

在 BOSS 直聘网页上找岗位、打招呼
打开汽水音乐，看广告领听歌权益
在美团上凑满减、点外卖，付款前问你
## 能做什么 你用一句话交代一件事，Mika 在手机上替你办。 ### 操作任何 App，不占你的屏幕 手机上装的 App 都能操作，不用事先适配：Mika 像人一样看屏幕、找按钮、点击输入，看得到就能操作。 - 在一块单独的后台屏上打开 App、读界面、点击、输入、滚动，你照常用手机；对话页上的小画面实时显示它在做什么。 - 能逐屏读长列表和聊天记录，比如「帮我总结一下某个群今天都聊了些啥」。 - 界面读不出来的 App（自己画界面、控件没有名字）也能用：Mika 用随 APK 自带的文字识别读屏上的字；配了能看图的模型时，还能看图找按钮和输入框。 - 能把一段文字直接分享进某个 App（发消息、记笔记），收件人和发送仍由 Mika 在那一页上点。 - 系统问「用哪个 App 打开」、装了两份的 App 问「打开哪一个」、一个 App 打开另一个 App（比如跳到付款页）时，Mika 认得出来：能处理的接着做，要你选或要你亲手处理的，会停下来请你在屏幕上操作。 - 需要你亲手处理的事（登录、验证码、付款）会发通知请你接管：App 挪到主屏，你处理完交还，Mika 重新核实再继续。 ### 内置浏览器 - 任何网站都能打开：在后台打开网页，用真实的点击和键盘输入操作页面，默认按电脑版网页打开。 - 能读页面正文，也能读页面自己收到的数据；支持下载、上传。 - 登录过的网站保持登录；侧栏「浏览器」里可以自己浏览，在这里登录的网站 Mika 办事时也能直接用。 - 翻页有节奏：同一个网站连着换页会停一停，对限制浏览快慢的网站停得更久；认得出风控拦截页，交给你处理而不是硬闯。 ### 此刻的屏幕 - 你在别的 App 里时，屏幕边上有一颗 Mika 悬浮胶囊，显示后台任务的进展、要你处理的事和结果，点开可以插话、回答、同意或停止。 - **双击胶囊**，把你正在看的这一屏发给 Mika，比如「这个怎么回」「帮我记下来」；也可以在卡片里截屏、补一句话再发。 ### 定时与条件任务 - 「明早 9 点提醒我」「每天早上看看天气，下雨才告诉我」「每周五做某件事」。 - 到点在原对话里执行，结果送回来；定时任务页可以暂停、改时间、立即执行、删除。 ### 随时插话、随时停 - 任务进行中可以继续说话，补充或更正要求，Mika 在下一步之前读到。 - 按停止后，Mika 会补几行交代：做了什么、看到了什么、发出了几次、哪些没做完。下次说「继续」它知道从哪接着做。 ### 询问 / 自主 - 默认是**询问**：只有花钱（下单、付款）先问你，发消息、提交、删除这些都直接做完。也可以换成**自主**，连付款也不先问。详见[下文](#询问--自主模式)。 ### 记忆 - 记住你明确说过的事实、偏好和做事方式（做事方式要你批准），可以查看、修改、删除；只从你自己说的话里记，密码、验证码、卡号这类不记。记忆加密保存在手机上。 ### 熟悉的 App 和网站，做得更快更稳 没有任何说明，Mika 也能看着屏幕把事办成。有些 App 和网站另外写了使用知识（入口在哪、常见做法、要注意什么），Mika 用到时自动查阅，少走弯路。比如进了聊天 App 直接知道怎么找联系人、翻聊天记录；打开招聘网站知道怎么筛岗位、打招呼。另有几类事情的通用做法。知识持续增加，人人可以补充：它们是放在 [`core/src/main/resources/knowledge/`](core/src/main/resources/knowledge/) 和 [`core/src/main/resources/skills/`](core/src/main/resources/skills/) 下的纯文本文件，[欢迎补充](#参与贡献)。 已经写了使用知识的（没写到的 App 和网站照样能用）： | 类别 | 内置 | |---|---| | **App** | Android 设置、百家号、哔哩哔哩、BOSS直聘、Chrome、得到、抖音、飞书、Gmail、即刻、快手、领英、QQ邮箱、Telegram、今日头条、Uber、Uber Eats、微信、微博、WhatsApp、闲鱼、小红书、知乎 | | **网站** | Amazon、哔哩哔哩、Google Calendar、豆瓣、抖音、Instagram、Gmail、Google Maps、Telegram、百度贴吧、微博、搜狗微信、WhatsApp、小红书、小宇宙、YouTube、知乎、BOSS直聘 | | **通用做法**（技能） | 把内容整理成文字、处理 PDF 文档、查清一件事、消息与邮件 | ### 成批的事 - 成批做事（比如逐个打招呼、投递）直接开始，不用先跟你确认名单；每两次之间隔开一段随机时间，做到网站自己说「到上限了」就停下告诉你。 ### 过程可查 - 回答下面列出来源（读过的页面、截图）；每次任务都有可回看的过程记录。 - 每次任务一行小结：总用时、和模型来回几次、用了多少 Token、多久看到第一次反馈；设置里的「Token 用量」按天、按服务商、按模型统计。 ### Linux 沙箱 - 每个对话一个工作区，可以跑 Python、Node 和 shell 命令，处理你发来的文件，把结果存到手机的「下载/Mika」。 - 默认断网，需要时在设置里的「文件与计算环境」打开「允许脚本联网」。只支持 arm64 设备。 ### 电脑上的 AI 工具也能用（CLI / MCP） 手机连着电脑时，电脑上的 AI 工具可以通过 MCP 把任务交给 Mika，在手机上办完把结果拿回去。一条命令打开，只经数据线、要令牌；也可以在设置里打开局域网连接（默认关）。见[电脑连接说明](docs/mcp.md)。 也可以安装[电脑端 CLI 与 Agent Skill](docs/cli.md),用 `mika connect`、`mika task run`、`mika task wait` 完成连接和任务交接。CLI 与 MCP 并列接入同一份手机任务服务,CLI 不需要配置 MCP;需要包含任务 API v1 的 APK。 ## 快速开始 ### 系统要求 | 项目 | 要求 | |---|---| | 安装、聊天、网页与沙箱任务 | 安卓 11 及以上（沙箱仅支持 arm64） | | 操作手机 App | 安卓 12 及以上；安卓 12、13 上后台操作可能影响主屏焦点 | | 推荐 | 安卓 14 及以上：后台屏有自己的焦点，不影响你在主屏打字；不同对话的任务同时进行也需要它 | | Linux 沙箱 | 仅 arm64 设备；其他设备照常安装，沙箱显示「此设备不支持」 | | 模型 | 一个支持工具调用的大模型 API Key | ### 1. 下载安装 从 [Releases](https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/releases/latest) 下载最新的 APK 安装。 ### 2. 无障碍（可以先跳过） Mika 靠无障碍读界面、做点按。不用手动去开：下一步配对成功后，Mika 会自己把它打开。从 GitHub 下载安装的 App，手动打开无障碍时常被系统拦下（提示「受限制的设置」），让 Mika 自己开能省掉这个麻烦。向导里到这一步时选「跳过」即可。 ### 3. 配对无线调试（只需一次） 打开设置里的「设置手机操作」向导，照着清单做：打开开发者选项、USB 调试、无线调试，然后用 6 位配对码配对。开发者选项里 Mika 没提到的开关不要动，有的会清除手机数据，比如「以 16KB 页面大小启动设备」。 第一次设置、卡在某一步，或者不知道配对码填在哪里：看[手机操作设置指南](docs/setup-guide.md)，每一步都写了在哪里点、怎么算成功、常见问题怎么办。 为什么要这一步：Mika 有一个内置的手机助手，要在后台屏上启动和操作 App，需要借用安卓自带的无线调试来启动它。全程在手机上完成，不需要电脑和数据线。配对过后，如果无线调试被系统关掉了（换 Wi-Fi、重启手机后安卓会关掉它），Mika 在你允许的前提下会自己把它重新打开。 手边有电脑和数据线的话，也可以不配对：先打开一次 Mika，插着线在电脑上运行 `adb shell sh /sdcard/Android/data/com.wangzan101.mika/files/usb-start.sh` 启动手机助手；但每次重启手机后都要再运行一次。这些也可以交给电脑上的 AI 助手，见[用电脑上的 AI 助手安装](docs/install-with-agent.md)。 只用上网、文件和聊天的话，这一步可以先跳过。 ### 4. 添加模型 打开设置里的「模型」（第一次打开 App 时也会引导你）。 内置 DeepSeek、通义千问、Kimi、智谱、硅基流动、火山方舟、MiniMax、阶跃星辰、腾讯混元、百度千帆、OpenRouter、OpenCode Go、Anthropic、Gemini、OpenAI、xAI、Mistral、Groq、Ollama、LM Studio 等服务商预设；其他服务商选「自定义」，OpenAI 兼容、Anthropic、Gemini、OpenAI Responses 接口都能接。 也可以不填 Key，用账号登录：添加服务商最上面是「用账号登录 · 不用填 Key」一组，点一家先看说明，再去浏览器里登录，登录后回到 Mika，能看到账号、可用的模型，可以直接设为主模型。 - **ChatGPT**（Plus 或 Pro，用你的套餐额度）：点「使用 ChatGPT 继续」，在浏览器里登录。 - **xAI / Grok**（SuperGrok 或 X Premium+ 订阅）：浏览器里打开 xAI 的确认页，核对手机上显示的短码后同意。这项登录借用 xAI 官方命令行工具的公开登录入口，不是 xAI 专门给 Mika 开的，xAI 可能限制这种用法；有的订阅档位登录后仍不能调用（提示 403），那时改用 xAI 的 API Key。 - **OpenRouter**：OpenRouter 官方给第三方应用的授权。同意后 OpenRouter 给 Mika 一把属于你的 Key（名字是 Mika），用量从你的 OpenRouter 余额里扣；不想用了，在 OpenRouter 的 Keys 页面删掉它。 退出登录只清这台手机上的登录信息。 1. 添加服务商：选一个预设，或选「自定义」填接口地址；填 API Key。Ollama、LM Studio 这类自己机器上跑的服务，地址预填了默认端口，改成那台机器的地址即可，Key 可不填。 2. 点「测试并保存」，连上第一家时会自动选一个主模型。 3. 主模型要支持工具调用。可选：看图模型（看懂界面、看图找按钮）、轻量模型（便宜快的即可，处理判断结局、提取记忆等小事）。 用 ChatGPT 登录或 Responses 接口的模型，可在各用途卡片下调整「思考强度」。默认用服务商默认值；选「用主模型」时也跟随它的强度，明确选同一个模型则可分别设置。档位优先采用服务商报告的列表；没报告时提供手动选项，实际支持情况以服务端为准。更高强度通常更慢、消耗更多 token。 ### 5. 试一试 空对话里有几条示例，点一下就能改了再发。也可以这样说： - 「帮我总结一下微信群今天都聊了些啥」 - 「打开小红书，帮我总结一下某个博主最近发的内容」 - 「帮我订明天早上 9:40、9:50、10:00 的闹钟」 - 「每天早上 8 点看看天气，下雨才告诉我」 ## 询问 / 自主模式 全局一个开关：设置里的「开发者选项」→「自主模式」，关着是询问，打开是自主。 | 模式 | 行为 | |---|---| | **询问**（默认） | 只有花钱的那一步先问你：下单、提交订单，或者页面上显示着应付金额时的确认、提交。卡片上写明在哪、买什么、多少钱，只能同意这一次或不同意。付款本身由你亲手完成。发消息、发帖、提交表单、删除、改设置这些都不问，直接做完。 | | **自主** | 连付款也不先问你，直接做完。成批做事时两次之间的间隔照样保留。 | -
